name: Guards and Wards

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: up to 2,500 square feet of floor space

summary: Ward up to 2,500 square feet of a building against intruders.
text: Corridors fill with fog, doors are arcane-locked or hidden, stairs fill with webs and passages confuse those who walk them; you add one more effect such as dancing lights, magic mouth, stinking cloud, a gust of wind or suggestion. Casting it every day for a year makes it permanent.
